items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, a little poetry and probably some song stuff without music and written mostly to my wife, Hilma.

ctx.x: So obviously you were a prolific reader even early on in life, and still are, obviously. Did you ever try and write anything? I know you’ve written many, many lyrics. Did you ever try any creative writing or even poetry or anything along those lines?
Well, a little poetry and probably some song stuff without music and written mostly to my wife, Hilma.
